purpose: bounded adaptive-rival revalidation after C6/C7 count reconciliation
classification_order: NEAR_TIE when either reference_gap lower bound is <= 0.5
VALIDATED_REVERSAL when separated and point-estimate actions differ
NO_CHANGE_CONTROL when separated and point-estimate actions match

sampling_units.reported_natural_frequency: state x named rival-policy variant row
sampling_units.live_candidate: unique ordered baseline/altered public-observation hash pair

go_no_go.go: at least 3 unique VALIDATED_REVERSAL public-observation pairs in these ten seeds
go_no_go.no_go: fewer than 3; stop adaptive-rival live pilot and do not add more seeds

prohibited: expanding beyond the ten registered seeds
lowering the uncertainty threshold after observing results
selecting probes based on Gemini behavior
supplying hidden rival policy identity to the Chief
